checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the 'Legs' checkpoint is untestable due to occlusion by water. All other visible checkpoints (Bill, Eyes, Body, Plumage, Wings, Tail) were marked as present and correct. I agree with these verdicts. The visual evidence strongly supports the presence of Mallard-specific features (iridescent green head, white neck ring, curled tail feathers). The Router was not too lenient; the features are distinct and match the taxonomy.
artifact_review: The Router identified minor texture anomalies in the water (severity 1.5) and blur in reflections (severity 1.0). I agree with these assessments. The water has a slightly 'painted' or repetitive look common in AI generations, but it is not structurally broken. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no graphics-level distortions (noise/compression), which aligns with the clean appearance of the ducks. The Animal Pose Auditor reported HIGH risk due to low confidence keypoints (88% < 0.5). However, per the Reflector guidelines, this is likely a domain shift issue (ViTPose trained on real photos vs. AI generation) rather than structural failure, especially since the Topology Boundary Auditor confirmed clean, high-confidence masks (score 1.0025) and no fragmentation. Therefore, I will not penalize the artifact score heavily for the pose auditor's warning, treating it as a false positive for structural defects.
alignment_reasoning: The image exhibits near-perfect class conformance. The Fine Grained Classifier confidently identified 'drake' (logit 6.78). All visible diagnostic checkpoints (plumage patterns, bill shape, tail curl) are present and anatomically correct. The only deduction is for the inability to verify submerged limbs, but the visible anatomy is flawless.
artifact_reasoning: The image is visually clean with no catastrophic structural failures. The primary artifacts are subtle: the water texture lacks natural chaotic randomness (slightly painterly/repetitive) and the reflections are optically simplified (smudged rather than refracted). These are minor aesthetic/physical inconsistencies typical of high-quality AI generations, warranting a moderate artifact score (3.65) rather than a perfect one, but significantly better than the 'mid' reference.
